categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Tests' label and modifies `test/functional/test_framework/util.py` to fix intermittent test failures.
categories.rationale: Fixes a recurring source of intermittent CI failures in the functional test framework assertion helper. According to issue #36394 and past issues (#24151, #25164), `wallet_send.py` fails when rare low-R ECDSA signatures are three bytes shorter than the default estimate, triggering false-positive test failures.
